purpose: Source-level quality assurance completed or attempted in separate GitHub Actions staging workflows; NOT a live risk feed or a count of insurable physical sites.
caveats: Rows have different source grains (regulatory tables, chemical filings, notifications, facility/provider context, polygons and raster observations). Never sum them as distinct facilities.

CI-indexed is ephemeral staging/index validation, not an accessible persistent production index. Every Lane A-D source still has zero verified deployed records in the authenticated facility application.
No insured physical site identity, exact footprint, facility-specific hazard, policy coverage, actual property loss or insurance claim has been independently established from these cohorts.
Publisher coverage and vintages vary. An unknown or blocked count is not zero events or zero risk.

lanes.name: Natural hazards
lanes.gate: Real FEMA/USFS sample ingestion passed; national flood coverage, untruncated paging, verified facility locations and production serving remain unresolved.

sources.name: FEMA NFHL flood polygons
sources.scope: 21 sampled polygon features across New Orleans (10), Houston (9), Sacramento (2); New Orleans transfer-truncated
sources.notes: Official FEMA responses; not a national layer or a property-specific flood determination.

sources.name: USFS Wildfire Hazard Potential 2023
sources.scope: Three official raster pixel observations; raw values 0, 231, 4155
sources.notes: Source raster pixels are neither wildfire incidents nor insured-property risk scores.

lanes.name: Environmental compliance
lanes.gate: Source records passed real-content QA in temporary indexes. Persistent query service and review-only facility crosswalk are not deployed; restricted RMP plans remain outside public scope.

sources.name: EPA ECHO national exporter
sources.scope: ECHO_EXPORTER.csv; native REGISTRY_ID; 3,146,109 valid coordinate pairs
sources.notes: 21,303 rejected for missing native REGISTRY_ID. Coordinate fields FAC_LAT/FAC_LONG corrected and revalidated; source records are not violation counts.

sources.name: EPA RCRAInfo national tables
sources.scope: Six regulatory tables; 1,630,839 facility-table records among the accepted source-table rows
sources.notes: Regulatory table rows are not 7 million different facilities; preserve native ID_NUMBER and member-table grain.

sources.name: EPA TRI 2024 U.S. Basic
sources.scope: 2024 chemical-level reporting rows, native TRIFD source field
sources.notes: Chemical reporting rows, not unique manufacturing facilities or actual releases at insured locations.

sources.name: EPA public RMP program interest
sources.scope: 21,853 distinct public FRS RMP-interest observations; excludes protected RMP/OCA records
sources.notes: Public regulated-program association only; restricted RMP plans and offsite-consequence analysis are not ingested.

lanes.name: Industrial incidents
lanes.gate: NRC and CSB source-normalized evidence passed QA, but not indexed/deployed. PHMSA hazardous-liquid archive returned HTTP 403; authorized alternate official distribution and separate hazmat data remain unresolved.

sources.name: USCG NRC 2025
sources.scope: Unique native SEQNOS notifications joined across workbook tables; 3,999 usable reported DMS coordinates
sources.notes: Initial spill/release notifications are unverified, and 17,534 notifications lack usable source coordinates. Incident-to-site attribution is not confirmed.

sources.name: U.S. Chemical Safety Board, Sept 2026
sources.scope: 675 dated-event source rows observed in official workbook
sources.notes: One record rejected for missing incident date. Investigations are selective, not a national accident census.

sources.name: PHMSA hazardous-liquid incidents 2010+
sources.scope: Official ZIP download blocked by HTTP 403 in networked CI
sources.notes: No accepted or rejected source count can be claimed. Missing source access is not evidence of zero pipeline incidents.

lanes.name: Utilities and interruption
lanes.gate: Actual EIA utility and disturbance rows were staged and locally indexed. Utility/provider identity is not a verified customer site; SEC primary filing downloads were HTTP 403, and insured BI losses remain unverified.

sources.name: EIA-861 final 2025
sources.scope: 979 reliability rows, 51 state aggregates, 11,893 county service-territory rows
sources.notes: 913 distinct utility IDs in reliability portion; 3 invalid-year records rejected. SAIDI/SAIFI are utility-level context only.

sources.name: EIA Electric Power Monthly table B.1
sources.scope: 2024 partial utility disturbance reports; derived source-row keys
sources.notes: Reported disruptions cannot automatically be assigned to insured physical sites.

sources.name: EIA Electric Power Monthly table B.2
sources.scope: 2023 annual utility disturbance reports; derived source-row keys
sources.notes: Publisher has no native event ID in table; source keys are derived, not original incident identifiers.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR primary-source BI filings
sources.scope: Three issuer references are candidates only; no official filing retrieved
sources.notes: SEC official site returned HTTP 403; zero actual verified issuer filing downloads and zero validated BI loss amounts.
